item.title: WordPress Appointment Booking Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m looking for someone who can design and build a 15-20 page WordPress site whose single focus is to turn visitors into confirmed appointments.
Here’s what I’m after: • A clean, responsive layout that highlights our services, builds trust, and makes the “Book Now” path obvious on every page. • An appointment system where visitors pick a service, see real-time availability, choose their preferred date/time, and lock it in instantly. (A plugin like Amelia, Bookly, or any proven equivalent is fine—just be sure it’s easy for my staff to manage from the dashboard.) • A live Google Reviews feed so prospects can read unfiltered feedback right on the site. • SEO foundations baked in—fast loading, technical setup, on-page metadata, and keyword-ready service pages so we start ranking from day one. • Standard pages such as Home, About, individual Service pages, Blog/News, and Contact are expected; feel free to suggest any others that help meet the 15-20 page range with all locations and services inside. Each page will have different content with interial links.
Once the build is complete, handoff should include login credentials, theme/plugin licenses (if any), and a quick walkthrough video so my team can add or edit content without needing a developer each time.

item.title: Outbid.lol Clobuild a competitive ranking and claiming platformne With Admin
item.description:
250-750 USD | build a website similar to Outbid.lol, but with addons such as allowing users to post unranked listings. Users can create posts, compete for ranked positions, and claim or take over a position on a public leaderboard.
The idea is to build a competitive ranking and claiming platform. Here's how I would approach it. 1. Website concept The website would allow users to: Create a listing: A user posts something they want to rank. A User could have no account as like outbid.lol if he only to post a ranked listing. if the user wants to post unranked listings or both, he needs to have an account. Claim a position: Other users can claim an available ranking position. Compete for rankings: Users can challenge or outbid the current position holder. Display a leaderboard: Show who currently holds each position (1st to 20th). Listings below 20th are unranked and positioned by random searching. Track activity: Show recent claims, challenges, and ranking changes. Manage profiles: Users have accounts, usernames, and ranking histories.
2. Main website pages Page Features Home Home button, categories button; Register button, Login button, Trending lists and popular rankings 15 or more ranked listing (under :all: category) and randomly drawn listings and related information, such as privacy Explore Browse all public lists Create list Publish a new ranking list List details View positions and claim them Leaderboard Show top-ranked users User profile Claimed positions and history Dashboard Admin panel: manage categories (one level or two levels, the total number of categories is unlimited, theoretically) and fees for ranking Fees for ranked and unranked listings
Poster: Manage your lists and claims Only post ranked listings, no need an account
Image title Ranked /unranked categories position Amount
URL or #candle
Home / cat 1
(pay)
description
A fees table will show Comparing minimum amount for position and the amount user choosing, if user’s amount greater than the minimum amount for the position, the process will proceed Use dodopayments.com as payment processor Should be able to take ApplePay, GooglePay, PayPal, Credit cards, ACH 3. How the ranking system should work
Based on the actual Outbid.lol model, the central mechanic is: A person submits their website, product, or social media profile. They choose how much they want to pay. Higher payments receive higher positions (an increment must be met for a higher position). Anyone can submit a higher bid to climb the leaderboard. If someone increases their own bid, they only pay the difference. Once payment is confirmed, the leaderboard updates automatically. With more higher bidding, the lowered previous bidding will be kept to lower position in order, for example, with 2 higher biddings added on, the initial 10th bidding will be moved down to 12th position, always above unranked listings
For example: Rank Product Total bid #1 Product A $500 #2 Product B $300 #3 Product C $150 #4 Product D $50
If someone bids $550 (suppose the minimum increment is $50), they become #1. Equal bids should be ordered by who paid first. This follows the core ranking model described by Outbid.lol.
If the minimum increment is $20, a user bids $320 will get his listing the #2 position.
A difference from outbid.lol: A poster can submit an unranked listing at a plain fee, for example $10 per month, or at a discounted fee: $100 for a year, and this fee is nonrefundable. Unranked listing can’t be upgraded to ranked listing
4. Recommended technology I'd recommend this stack for a scalable first version: Component Technology Frontend Next.js Design Tailwind CSS Database Supabase / PostgreSQL Authentication Supabase Auth Payments Stripe or another supported payment provider, or use payment processor such as dodopayments.com
Hosting Vercel AI features OpenAI API
Important backend features: Automatic ranking calculations. Secure payment verification through webhooks. Duplicate listing detection. User account management. Bid and payment history. Admin dashboard and moderation. Important: Never update a ranking just because the user clicked Pay. Only update it after verified payment confirmation.
5. Design direction I'd suggest a modern dark interface with: Black or charcoal background. Purple/blue accent colors. Large #1 leaderboard spotlight. Clear bid amounts. Green claim buttons. Live ranking updates. Responsive mobile layout.
How should people claim a ranked position? 1. Ranking / claiming method Paid bidding — users pay to claim or outbid positions, like Outbid.lol. Free claiming — users claim available positions without paying. Both — free listings with paid upgrades to higher positions.
2. What can people post? Websites, products, and AI tools Anything — users create their own lists and rankings People, profiles, and social media accounts Custom categories and user-created leaderboards
the complete website, including frontend, backend, database, payment integration, and admin and poster dashboard.

item.title: Fix WordPress Header/Footer Layout
item.description:
20-250 GBP | A recent WordPress update broke the site-wide header and footer built with my header-footer plugin. Both elements still render, yet everything is out of place: the menu, logo and navigation links have shifted, spacing and alignment are off, and text, colours and buttons no longer match the theme. The problem appears on every single page, not just the home page.
The task is to trace whatever changed in the update—whether it is the plugin, theme overrides, or custom CSS/JS—then correct the code so the header and footer regain their original layout and styling across the entire site. Please make the fix in a child theme or custom CSS file so future core, theme or plugin updates do not undo the work.
Deliverables • Header and footer display correctly on all pages, desktop and mobile • Menu, logo and links are positioned as before and work normally • Spacing, alignment, colours and button styles are restored to match the rest of the theme • Brief changelog or notes outlining what was modified for future reference
Testing in multiple modern browsers before hand-off will confirm the issue is fully resolved.
The two images show before and after the WP update.

item.title: ClickFunnels Website Improvements & Click Funnells Utilisation
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I'm a director of a small Australian business specialising in Positive Behaviour Support (PBS).
We have an existing ClickFunnels website, but our original developer is no longer available. I'm looking for an experienced ClickFunnels freelancer who can help with two main areas.
1. Website Review & Improvements
Review our existing website and recommend practical improvements.
Improve messaging layout (I will provide messaging and wording), layout (including grapics) and overall user experience.
Ensure the website clearly communicates our services, philosophy and approach.
Make basic content updates and ensure the site works well on mobile devices.
2. ClickFunnels Training & Better Utilisation
I'd also like someone who can work alongside me and teach me how to better use the platform, including:
Publishing blogs and educational content.
Building and managing an email subscriber list.
Creating newsletters and simple email campaigns.
Setting up basic automations and follow-ups.
Identifying other useful ClickFunnels features that could benefit a small business.
What I'm Looking For
We're a small, growing business, so I'm not looking for a complete website rebuild or an expensive ongoing marketing package.
Ideally, I'd like someone who can provide practical, one-on-one guidance via Zoom, help implement some initial improvements and teach me how to manage things myself moving forward.
I'm reasonably comfortable using technology and more so AI tools )(albeit would love someone who can help me better utilize AI - widgets etc for our business)
I'd prefer to start with a paid website review and improve, then agree on priorities and any additional work required.
I'm based in Australia but happy to work with freelancers anywhere in the world. Good English is essential.
Please let me know your relevant ClickFunnels experience, hourly rate and approach to this type of project.
Thanks, Shaun

item.title: Fix Sidebar Dropdown Functionality
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need help making existing sidebar dropdown boxes work across all sections of my Dreamweaver website. Currently, the dropdown options link to pages, but only within one main section. I need them to link correctly to pages in the same folder as the sidebar.
Requirements: - Ensure dropdown options function correctly on all pages within the same folder as the sidebar. - Maintain current design and functionality of the website.
Ideal Skills & Experience: - Proficient in Adobe Dreamweaver - Experience with HTML/CSS and website navigation - Attention to detail and problem-solving skills
More info from potential client: The Dreamweaver site in question is vistabookencore.com. To get to the problem issue, bring up the site and click on an e for encore and that will take to a list of the three sections: VistaBooks History Reprints, VistaBooksOnline, and VistaBooks Vintage,
Cuirrently I am concerned with only the left sidebar "sidebar-l.html". It is located in the VistaBooks Online section, "vbonline" foider. (There is a "sidebar-l copy" file in the site but only there if needed for a backup restore. Another recent backup is in a separate disk on the computerr.)
Go to VistaBooks Online where a home page will come up with sidebars (sidebars also appear on other pages in this section.) In the left sidebar are three sections. Test the dropdown boxes in the VistaBooks History Reprints section; their links to pages all work, ' though sidebars need to be set up on those pages, too. Test links in the VistaBooks Online section; none work, links just stall. Links in the VistaBooks Vintage section do not work as I have not finished them pending resolution of the problem in VistaBooks Online, but would seem to have the same fix once found. I have also below the VistaBooks Vintage section inserted a test dropdown box with links to pages in another published website, VistaBooks Outlet; all these work. The code used for each of the dropdown box lists is like this: "<select id="setit1" size="1" name="test1"> <option value = "https:/www.vistabooksencore.com/vbreprint/pagesvb/vbnogo.html" style="background-color: #69359c">REPRINTS SUBJECTS</option> </select> <input type="button" value="GO" onClick="window.open(setit1.options[setit1.selectedIndex].value)" style="background-color: #69359c"> There are 20 dropdown box lists like the above example in the sidebar, with the "setit1" and "test1" values rising one at a time to "setit20" and "test20" but with the size ="1" staying the same. The first 5 dropdown boxes are for VistaBooks History Reprints; all work. The dropdownboxes from 6 thru 12 are for VistaBooks Online; all fail. The dropdownboxes from 13 thru 19 are for VistaBooks Vintage; all fail but are mainly yet to be set up). The dropdown box 20 for VistaBooks Outlet all works, this to an external published website that is intended to be replaced by vistabooksencore.com. The links in all the dropdown boxes are presently set, as an example, to "https://www.vistabooksencore.com/vbreprint/pagesvb/vbwest.html" but I have tried other combinations, omitting folders and subfolders to only using the file name in the links. I have not found a format for this that works. Some navigation links are still to be added, which I will do once the sidebar issue is resolved.
Assuming the site and sidebar with dropdown boxes can stay in their current format it may be that I can make needed changes with guidance. For instance, what is the correct format for the links in the dropdown boxes, in what folders or main file should the sidebar files be placed? Do the files need to be adjusted if they are to be placed in different folders, and how?
Copies of pertinent Dreamweaver files could be made available if there is a way to do this.

I need someone who works with Brilliant Directories on a regular basis and understands its built-in tools—content widgets, dynamic lead forms, member features, SEO settings, and payment/configuration options—so the job is completed quickly without trial and error. Your task is to:
• Structure categories and sub-levels that make sense for the niche, • Configure the listing pages so each business profile looks professional and pulls in the right data fields, • Set up the lead form workflow (auto-emails, notifications, CRM pipeline inside BD), • Optimise the homepage and search/index pages for speed and on-page SEO, and • Test everything before hand-off, ensuring visitors can browse listings smoothly and send enquiries without glitches.
Please plan the work so it’s handed back as a turn-key directory: all settings documented, demo listings in place to prove functionality, and clear instructions for day-to-day management. If you’ve launched other BD sites, let me know; that experience will be the deciding factor.

item.title: Senior UX/UI Designer to Review and Elevate Two Brand Websites
item.description: 15-25 USD/hr | Category: UX/UI Design. Upwork had auto-tagged it “Logo Design”, so I changed it. Skills: Figma, Web Design, UX Design, UI Design, Visual Communication, Responsive Design, Style Guide. Scope: Medium, 1 to 3 months, Expert level, not contract-to-hire, worldwide talent. Description: It introduces both brands. It says plainly that you don’t want anyone from the betting or gambling space, and that you want fresh eyes and taste in art and design. The work is: audit both sites, propose a design direction with mockups, implement the designs, and get mobile right. The portfolio is the top requirement. Applicants have to name their 2 or 3 best projects and say what they notice first on a new website, which filters out copy-paste proposals.

item.title: Optimize Wix Art Portfolio
item.description:
10-15 GBP/hr | I already host my artwork on a Wix site, but right now it feels more like a storage room than a gallery. I need someone who knows Wix inside-out to turn this into a clean, engaging portfolio that keeps visitors browsing—and ideally clicking on well-placed ads so the site can begin generating revenue.
Here’s what I’m after: • Re-structure the galleries so each section is organised by art style or medium. Only my paintings and drawings will be shown; no other categories are needed. • Improve navigation and page flow so viewers are naturally encouraged to keep moving from piece to piece. • Identify and add tasteful ad spots (Google AdSense or a comparable network) that won’t detract from the artwork but will still earn clicks. • Tidy up image metadata, page titles and on-page SEO so the portfolio stands a better chance of being discovered in search. • Make sure everything looks right on mobile as well as desktop.
I’ll provide full access to the existing Wix project along with all original image files. The finished site should be live on my domain, fully responsive, and ready to start serving ads without compromising the look and feel of the art. If you’ve done similar Wix gallery or portfolio work before, I’d love to see it.

item.title: Publish Case Facts Online
item.description:
15-25 USD/hr | My name and professional standing were questioned in a recent dispute, yet every formal finding shows the accusers were untruthful. I now need a concise, fully verifiable account of the case published on a public website or blog so anyone searching the matter can quickly see the documented facts—nothing more, nothing less.
Scope of work • Distill all available records (court rulings, transcripts, exhibits) into a neutral, fact-only narrative that avoids any potentially defamatory wording. • Build a clean, fast-loading web page or small blog—WordPress, static HTML, or another straightforward platform is fine—where that narrative, supporting documents, and source citations can live. Basic SEO (clear URL, title tag, meta description) is expected so the page can be found when my name or the case is Googled. • Provide guidance on future updates should new material surface.
Quality bar • Every sentence must be traceable to a public document I can supply. • Tone stays factual and restrained; no rhetoric or commentary. • Design remains minimal yet professional, readable on mobile and desktop.
When you reply, include a detailed project proposal: outline your workflow for verifying statements, structuring the content, choosing the web platform, and delivering the finished page ready to publish.

item.title: Build Complete eCommerce Store
item.description:
2-8 USD/hr | I want to launch an online store that sells physical products which will be shipped to customers. At first the catalogue will hold no more than 20 items, yet I need every core storefront function in place from day one.
The project covers: • Clean, responsive product pages and a smooth shopping-cart experience. • Secure online payments (Stripe, PayPal, credit-card) with automated order-confirmation emails. • Real-time shipping rates, label generation and customer order-tracking updates.
Please set the store up on the platform you feel is most reliable—Shopify, WooCommerce or another SaaS solution—so long as it allows me to add new products easily, manage inventory, and view sales reports without touching code.
Before hand-off I’ll need a quick walkthrough or short guide that shows how to: – add or edit products, – process and fulfil an order, – issue refunds if necessary.
The store is considered complete once a test order flows from checkout through payment, confirmation email and generated tracking number without errors.

item.title: Full-Service Amazon Store Management
item.description:
8-15 USD/hr | We're launching an Amazon store and need a comprehensive, end-to-end management service. We need you to build out the store design per our concepts. And then expert marketing to drive visibility and sales. Mainly clothing, accessories, home & living items.
Requirements: - Store setup and product listing: We need an appealing and optimized store, with all products listed professionally from the get-go. - Product sourcing: We expect high-quality, trendy clothing that's competitively priced. - Inventory management: Efficient tracking and management of stock levels. - Customer service and returns: Excellent customer service to handle inquiries and returns promptly and professionally.
Ideal Skills: - Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly on Amazon - Strong background in marketing and promotions - Excellent inventory management skills - Customer service expertise - Proven positive track record with end to end Amazon store management. - Experience with Printful to Amazon integrations (Not required but useful)
We will be using Printful as our print-on-demand and dropshipping service. It integrates with Amazon. Please familiarize yourself with that platform.
